title: Bayesian Propensity Score Predictive Inference for Extending Trial Findings to Target Populations
abstract: arXiv:2610.31915v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The CODIACS Vanguard randomized trial compared a depression care intervention with usual care for patients with persistent depressive symptoms following acute coronary syndrome. We assess whether its findings can be extended to broader patient populations represented by two cohorts constructed from the All of Us electronic health records. This extension is challenging when treatment effects vary across covariates whose distributions differ between trial and target populations. We develop Bayesian Propensity Score Predictive Inference (PSPI), an interaction-based outcome modeling framework that combines Bayesian additive regression trees for potentially high-dimensional covariates with natural cubic splines of the sampling propensity score. translated_title: 贝叶斯倾向得分预测推断：将试验结果推广至目标人群
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.31915v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：CODIACS Vanguard随机对照试验比较了抑郁护理干预与常规护理对急性冠脉综合征后持续存在抑郁症状患者的疗效。我们评估其研究结果能否推广到由All of Us电子健康记录构建的两个队列所代表的更广泛患者群体。当治疗效果随协变量变化，而这些协变量在试验人群与目标人群中的分布存在差异时，这种推广具有挑战性。我们提出了贝叶斯倾向得分预测推断（PSPI），这是一种基于交互作用的结果建模框架，将用于潜在高维协变量的贝叶斯加性回归树与抽样倾向得分的自然三次样条相结合。该方法包含两种变体：一种仅在治疗效果成分中单独使用样条，另一种则在预后成分和治疗效果成分中均使用样条。样条成分允许对所选……
tldr: 本文提出贝叶斯倾向得分预测推断（PSPI）框架，结合贝叶斯加性回归树与倾向得分自然三次样条，解决了当治疗效果存在效应修饰因素异质性时随机试验结果向目标人群推广的难题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Bayesian Propensity Score Predictive Inference (PSPI), a framework combining Bayesian additive regression trees with natural cubic splines of the propensity score to generalize randomized trial findings to target populations despite treatment effect heterogeneity.
